description: FREE, no key, no sign-in: the tape's latest price for one market (NQ, ES, YM, BTC, ETH or SOL) with the time of that 1-minute close and whether the tape is stale. Use it whenever an agent needs a current price; it is the same tape every Cubicle vault checks its orders against. For a window of candles use tape (needs a key).
name: price
